items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He was one of the cleanest, one of the cleanest trumpet players that I ever heard.

ctx.x: We didn't mention Bobby Starks, did we? Can you tell me about him?
Bobby Starks. He was one of the cleanest, one of the cleanest trumpet players that I ever heard.
He was a short, kind of plump, round guy?
